summary: Plaid released an August product update adding identity verification, bank linking, onboarding, and fraud features.
Alkami expanded its Plaid integration to add account linking, financial visibility, and enriched transaction data in digital banking.
Fiserv said it is partnering with Cognition to use Devin AI for core banking modernization.
FinCEN finalized a rule ending beneficial ownership reporting for U.S. companies and persons, retaining limited reporting for some foreign companies.
FDX launched standards work for safe financial data sharing with agentic AI, raising expectations for consent, identity, and audit controls.
CFPB recognized FDX as the first standard-setting body for open banking, increasing its influence on the rule environment.
CFPB said it will stop publishing unverified complaint narratives and visualizations.
Plaid and Sierra partnered to embed secure bank account linking inside AI agent conversations.
Fiserv partnered with Cognition to use Devin AI for core banking modernization.
The CFPB’s Section 1033 open-banking rewrite moved back into active rulemaking, with a new proposal to OIRA and an interim final rule expected.
entities: Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs
